primary_title: Endothelial cell attachment and spreading on human tenascin is mediated by alpha 2 beta 1 and alpha v beta 3 integrins
decision_basis: The tenascin-C integrin review identifies alpha2beta1 among the tenascin-C receptors and cites the primary endothelial adhesion and receptor-identification study.

primary_title: Binding of alpha v beta 1 and alpha v beta 6 integrins to tenascin-C induces epithelial-mesenchymal transition-like change of breast cancer cells
decision_basis: The tenascin-C integrin reviews identify alphaVbeta6 as an RGD-dependent tenascin-C receptor and cite the primary cancer-cell binding study.
